name: Edition House
description: An art-print storefront with six original editions, artwork and room views, product configuration, a persistent local bag, and a complete editorial journal.

notes.layout: full-bleed interior hero, art archive, artwork/room views, series stories, room gallery, six product pages and journal
notes.motion: room carousel, artwork-view transitions, product-detail disclosure, reduced-motion fallback
notes.interaction: filter and sort art, switch room views, choose print size/frame/finish, calculate a local bag, search and export a selection
notes.provenance: Original ten-page commerce study with independent art, brand, writing, room scenes and local shopping behavior. Prices and editions are illustrative; no orders or payments are submitted.

credits.referenceName: The Print Loft, discovered through Minimal Gallery
